FN-QN73Z51-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 396
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Kenneth Pascal
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/12/2025
House Bill 396 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of county tax
officials to issue certain veterans a tentative certificate of permanent and total disability, under
the provisions of this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue to
develop the tentative certificate form.
